children: Singhal joins Hindustan Construction Company with over three decades of experience across infrastructure, urban development, airports and large-scale project execution

Hindustan Construction Company (HCC) has appointed Vivek Singhal as Chief Executive Officer (CEO). Singhal brings over three decades of experience in infrastructure development, construction and project execution, having held senior leadership positions at GMR Group, Tata Projects and Alpine Bau GmbH. His experience spans urban infrastructure, metro rail systems, airports and international construction projects.

Before joining HCC, Singhal served as CEO of GMR Airports Limited in Singapore, a position he held from November 2018. During his tenure at GMR Group, he led airport-related operations and drew on his experience in infrastructure development and multinational project execution.

Earlier, he served as Chief Operating Officer at GMR Group from March to May 2013 and as Vice President from April 2012 to February 2013. His responsibilities across these roles added to his experience in infrastructure operations and business leadership.

Singhal was Chief Operating Officer for Urban Infrastructure at Tata Projects from January 2014 to November 2018. He also served as CEO of the Tata Projects–Balfour Beatty joint venture between June 2013 and January 2014.

At Tata Projects, his experience included urban infrastructure development and the execution of complex projects. His broader career has involved work on metro rail systems, airports and major infrastructure developments across international markets.

Earlier, Singhal worked at Alpine Bau GmbH in Singapore as Branch Manager and Project Director. He began his career as a field engineer at Jai Prakash Industries after completing his civil engineering degree.

Singhal's professional experience includes leading business turnarounds, driving growth and managing large construction projects. His stated areas of focus include sustainable development, green infrastructure and the adoption of next-generation technologies in construction.

His career has also included work on underground metro rail systems in Singapore and airport projects across several emerging economies. These assignments have given him experience in managing complex infrastructure programmes and multinational teams.
Singhal holds a Bachelor of Engineering degree in Civil Engineering from Motilal Nehru National Institute of Technology, Allahabad, where he graduated with first-class honours.

His appointment brings experience in infrastructure operations, international project execution and construction business leadership to HCC as he takes charge of the company's business and growth priorities.
